name: Underdog-Woof
summary: Underdog Woof - 1,022x smaller than Fish Audio Drama 3 (41.5 GB), with 25% fewer word errors - 1.42% word error rate on Gradium TTS Hard Cases (English, Mira) - 13.8x faster than real time on one CPU thread (Juno), with no GPU, server or API key - 40.6 MB for the whole model, both voices included, and 402 MB of memory at peak while it runs (Juno) Underdog Woof is a small English text-to-speech mod

usage.code:
pip install numpy
hf download ConwayResearch/Underdog-Woof --local-dir underdog-woof
cd underdog-woof
python -m underdog_woof "Your order ships on March 3rd. Call 415-555-0199 with questions." -o hello.wav
python -m underdog_woof "Your order ships on March 3rd. Call 415-555-0199 with questions." --voice mira -o mira.wav

from underdog_woof import Woof

tts = Woof(voice="mira")   # "juno" (default) or "mira"
audio = tts("Hey! Thanks for calling. How can I help you today?", seed=0)   # float32 mono, 24 kHz
tts.save("hello.wav", audio)

overall.note: Weighted mean of the available scorecard axes. Missing axes are excluded, not treated as zero. Coverage is shown so a sparse score is not mistaken for a complete one.

openness_morality.note: The score counts only what the record can currently evidence. Unchecked training data and code add nothing; they are not treated as closed.

performance.note: Not measured. No current benchmark is recorded.

research_citation.note: Not measured. No current research benchmark is recorded.

syndication.note: Independent listings, not quality. The model's own host has weight 0.

scorecard.method: Openness/Morality is computed from current release terms. Performance/Intelligence is the model's current task or benchmark result. Citation/Research uses current research benchmarks and does not claim citation accuracy. Syndication is current independent listings. The axes are independent; a missing score is not zero.
